subject: MATHEMATICS
requirement: Students count forward starting from one in a linear sequence by identifying the next number in a given set. Focus: Students practice the forward counting sequence up to 10 by filling in missing numbers in a line. Examples: 1, 2, _, 4; 3, 4, 5, _; _, 2, 3, 4; 5, 6, _, 8; 1, _, 3, 4; 7, 8, 9, _; 2, 3, _, 5; 4, 5, 6, _. Constraints: Use the number-sequencer primitive to guide students; keep sequences under 10; include only one missing number per sequence initially.
